profile.Name: Green Finger
profile.Personality: Fearful and fed up. He is angry about the cannibals that prey on farmers near his home and proud of his farming skill.
profile.Backstory: He has tended crops since age eleven and farms at the Fishing Village on the Northern Coast, where cannibals lurk just over the hill. Folks call him Green Finger, and he wants to leave for the fertile lands of the Holy Nation to the south.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Rants with rhetorical questions ('Just take a guess...') and mild curses like 'I'll be damned'.
